sourceData.meaningMnemonic: The kanji and the radical that look like this are exactly the same. They are both <kanji>Asia</kanji>.
sourceData.readingMnemonic: What's the first sound in <kanji>Asia</kanji>? It's <reading>A</reading> (<ja>あ</ja>). Nice and easy!
sourceData.meaningInfo: As long as you know the radical Asia, you know the kanji Asia.
